title: The Pottery Wheel
description: Maya tries pottery to step outside her comfort zone, but a messy failure forces her to redefine what perfection really means.

scenes.narration: I swore I would try one new thing this semester, so I signed up for ceramics. Thirty seconds in, my clay collapsed into a grey puddle.
scenes.visual: Teen girl staring dismayed at a messy blob of grey clay on a spinning wheel in a sunlit art studio

scenes.narration: Everyone else was crafting sleek vases, while I couldn't even keep my hands steady. The instructor offered to help, but panic made me pull back.
scenes.visual: Focus on hesitant hands covered in wet clay hovering over a pottery wheel

scenes.narration: I walked out of class feeling like a total fake. I almost dropped the course right then on my phone in the hallway.
scenes.visual: Teenage girl leaning against a locker wall looking down at her phone with an anxious expression

scenes.narration: That night, I watched videos of artists embracing imperfection. They didn't fight the clay, they guided it gently without forcing symmetry.
scenes.visual: Glow of a smartphone screen reflecting on a girl face in a dark bedroom at night

scenes.narration: The next week, I sat down and let go of trying to make a perfect bowl. Instead of fixing a wobble, I turned it into a textured lip.
scenes.visual: Girl hands shaping messy clay into a unique rustic bowl with focused determination

scenes.narration: When it came out of the kiln, it wasn't neat, but it was mine. A classmate even asked how I got that custom wave shape.
scenes.visual: Smiling teen girl holding a glazed ceramic bowl with wavy edges near a sunlit window

scenes.narration: Sometimes the best creations come from leaning into your mistakes. Follow along for more stories every single day.
scenes.visual: Young woman smiling warmly at the camera in a cozy room with soft warm lighting

character_reference: A slender young adult college student with messy dark brown hair and warm hazel eyes, wearing a dark green canvas apron over a grey long-sleeved shirt. They feature round wire-rimmed glasses and a faint smudge of grey clay on their right cheek.
